title: Chocolate peanut butter protein yogurt bowl
description: Greek yogurt whipped with double chocolate protein powder and cocoa, swirled with peanut butter and banana.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Add the banana just before eating.

steps.text: Slice the banana. Warm the peanut butter for 10 seconds so it drizzles.
Whisk the protein powder, cocoa and milk into a paste, then whisk it into the yogurt until smooth.
Divide among 3 bowls, swirl in the peanut butter and top with the banana.
Refrigerate the yogurt base covered; add the banana when serving.
